outcome_summary: Checkpoints 01 and 02 plus the R30-CERT-001 operator-cancellation and diagonal-screening theorems are unconditionally verified (26/26 Lean 4.35.0 headlines in Rule30PrizeClosure, 28 replayed constants, 0 new axioms). In the PSMSL-projected sideways basis, columns -1 and -2 collapse to degree <= 1 for all words, Law L2 screens 11 patterns to depth -2, Law L3 cancels the unscreened right-half variable out of X_{t,-2} XOR X_{t,-3} on 101 patterns, and left diagonals D0..D5 eliminate all free left-cone variables for T <= 6, collapsing 151/154 (98.05%) of mixed-word Nullstellensatz certificates across T=0..6, P=2..4 (including 77/77 in G2 and 28/28 in G3) to MUS size 1 and degree 0. Universal lifting (M4) is isolated to bridging the max(0, T-6) interior cone gap for T >= 7 (spatial_bridge_to_left_diagonals_implies_problem1).
